This can help reduce estate taxes, as you can typically exclude a certain amount of money from federal estate taxes each year.
3. Consider using a pay-on-death (POD) account: POD accounts, such as a revocable living trust or a special needs trust, can help you transfer assets to your heirs without incurring estate taxes.
